g.text: Skipped 1 admin principal (already hold full access); 1 AWS default role. Add --include-admins /
Hidden to avoid noise: broad reads, Lambda invoke, AssumeRole and SSM sessions. Add
--include-access for the read-all / invoke-anything cases. Which paths reach your data is
Each "to break it" line is one way to cut the path. Removing the permission or scoping it to
what the principal needs depends on your business context.
Can attach the AdministratorAccess managed policy to this user
Can create a new long-lived access key for this user
Can reset this user's console password and take it over
Can launch an EC2 fleet with an instance profile and reach its IMDS credentials
Scope iam:PassRole for roles trusting ec2.amazonaws.com; restrict
Can launch an EC2 instance with this role and run code as it
Remove iam:PassRole for this role or scope it with iam:PassedToService.
Can create a new default version of this attached managed policy
Can write an inline admin policy directly onto this user
Can roll this attached managed policy back to a more-permissive saved version
Remove iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion from the principal; prune stale
Can pass this role to a new Lambda function and run code as it
Remove iam:PassRole for this role or scope it with iam:PassedToService.
